blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
In English, we use possessive pronouns to show who something belongs to. We say my job, your team, his office, her role. These small words help us talk about people clearly and kindly.

At Czarnikow, this is very useful. You can say "My role is to help people" or "Your manager is Sophie." You can talk about a colleague too: "Her task is important" or "His department is sales."

Today you learn 5 important words: role, manager, colleague, department, and task. We go step by step. You can do it!

items.q: What do possessive pronouns show?
items.why: "we use possessive pronouns to show who something belongs to."

items.q: How many important words do you learn today?
items.why: "Today you learn 5 important words: role, manager, colleague, department, and task."

items.q: Who is your manager, according to the text?
items.why: "Your manager is Sophie."

items.q: The text says English "helps us talk clearly and kindly." The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: you should only learn hard words
small words can be very useful
items.why: Inferência: o texto valoriza palavras pequenas (my, your, his, her) como úteis e gentis.

items.q: "We go step by step. You can do it!" This suggests the lesson is…
options: only about the city of London
very difficult and only for experts
items.why: Inferência: o tom é de encorajamento, feito para iniciantes irem devagar.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie apresentar a equipe de RH. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi! My name is Sophie. I am the manager of the HR team here at Czarnikow. Welcome to the team! Let me tell you about my colleagues, one by one. It is easy. Just listen.

First, this is Gil. He is my colleague and my friend. His role is to help new people, like you. His office is in London, and his desk is next to mine. If you have a question, you can ask him.

Next, this is Ana. She is very kind. Her department is sales, but she works with us too. Her task today is to send the reports. Her task is important, so she is very busy this morning.

And this is Tom. He is new, like you. His first task is small, but it is a good start. Our team is small, but we help each other every day. That is our way here.

So, remember: my role is to guide the team. Your role is to learn, step by step. Our goal is to grow together. Do not worry, and do not rush. You can do it!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Who is Sophie?
options: The manager of the HR team
items.why: "My name is Sophie. I am the manager of the HR team."

items.q: What is Gil's role?
items.why: "His role is to help new people."

items.q: What is Ana's task today?
items.why: "Her task today is to send the reports."

items.q: Sophie says Ana's department is sales, "but she works with us too." This suggests that…
options: Ana only helps the sales team
people can help more than one team
the HR team is very big
items.why: Inferência: mesmo sendo de vendas, Ana colabora com o RH — as pessoas ajudam mais de uma equipe.

items.q: Sophie says "Our goal is to grow together." Her tone is…
items.why: Inferência: ela dá boas-vindas e diz "You can do it!" — o tom é acolhedor.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "My role is to help new people." A role is…
items.why: Role = papel / função na empresa.

items.q: "Sophie is the manager of the team." A manager is a person who…
items.why: Manager = gerente: a pessoa que lidera a equipe.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Gil is my ___. We work in the same team."
items.why: Colleague = colega de trabalho.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Her ___ is sales, but she helps HR too."
items.why: Department = departamento (a área da empresa).

items.q: "His first task is small, but it is a good start." A task is…
options: a job or piece of work to do
items.why: Task = tarefa: um trabalho a fazer.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Sophie, can you help out with the reports?" To help out means to…
items.why: Help out = dar uma ajuda, ajudar em algo.

items.q: "Tom is new, so we show him around the office." To show someone around means to…
options: give them a tour and introduce places
items.why: Show around = mostrar o lugar, apresentar o ambiente a alguém novo.

items.q: "Please fill in this form with your name." To fill in means to…
items.why: Fill in = preencher (um formulário).

items.q: "Let's catch up tomorrow about your first task." To catch up means to…
items.why: Catch up = colocar o papo em dia, conversar.

items.q: "Good job! Keep it up, Tom." Keep it up means…
items.why: Keep it up = continue assim, mantenha o bom trabalho.
